source_scope: fr1/desk_lightswitch direct greedy searches and completed Step-P C2F grid

selection.source_metric: historical keyframe evo_ape ATE mean with --align --correct_scale
selection.selection_rule: Show the gray control; the direct parents needed to interpret each C2F cell; the global C2F best; a strong positive synergy; and a high-ranked direct parent for which C2F is worse.

candidates.label: gray_baseline
candidates.role: Photometric grayscale baseline; no learned tracking features.

candidates.label: unet_enc1_direct_c4_d00_d05_d06_d18_d30
candidates.role: Direct coarse parent C4, selected because it participates in the strongest U-Net C2F results.

candidates.label: unet_enc1_direct_c2_d00_d05_d06_d17_d18_d30
candidates.role: Direct coarse parent C2, needed to interpret the C2F-B schedule contrast.

candidates.label: unet_enc0_direct_f1_d02_d03_d07_d12_d13_d14
candidates.role: Direct fine parent F1: global direct U-Net optimum on fr1/desk_lightswitch.

candidates.label: unet_enc0_direct_f2_d03_d07_d12
candidates.role: Direct fine parent F2: the three-channel near-optimum.

candidates.label: unet_enc0_direct_f5_d02_d03_d07_d12_d13
candidates.role: Direct fine parent F5, included because it has the clearest positive C2F synergy.

candidates.label: unet_c2f_a_f1_c4_negative_high_parent
candidates.role: C2F-A negative control: on fr1 lightswitch it is worse than the globally best direct fine parent F1.

candidates.label: unet_c2f_a_f2_c4_global_best
candidates.role: C2F-A global U-Net C2F optimum on fr1 lightswitch; compare against both direct parents.

candidates.label: unet_c2f_a_f5_c4_positive_synergy
candidates.role: C2F-A positive synergy case: 12.8% lower fr1-lightswitch ATE than direct F5.

candidates.label: unet_c2f_b_f2_c2_variant_contrast
candidates.role: C2F-B schedule contrast: on fr1 lightswitch it is worse than direct F2, despite the same fine scale family.
